# PCA
```{r}
set.seed(123)
rec <- recipe(~ ., data = health_data) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%          # handle NA numeric
  step_impute_mode(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%            # handle NA categorical
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) %>%  # one-hot encode chars/factors
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%                             # drop zero-variance cols
  step_normalize(all_predictors())                          # standardize

rec_prep <- prep(rec, training = health_data)
X <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = NULL)

pca_fit <- prcomp(X, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)  # already normalized

summary(pca_fit)

scores <- as.data.frame(pca_fit$x)
```

```{r}
# pca_fit from prcomp()
lambda <- pca_fit$sdev^2
pve <- lambda / sum(lambda)
cum_pve <- cumsum(pve)

k <- length(lambda)
dfp <- data.frame(
  component = 1:k,
  lambda = lambda,
  cum_pct = 100 * cum_pve
)

library(ggplot2)

# scale cumulative % onto the left axis (so we can draw a right axis)
scale_factor <- max(dfp$lambda) / 100

ggplot(dfp, aes(x = component)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = lambda), fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cum_pct * scale_factor), color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = cum_pct * scale_factor), color = "darkgreen", size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 80 * scale_factor, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgreen") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:k) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Eigenvalue (lambda)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "Cumulative Var (%)")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Component", title = "Scree plot with cumulative variance") +
  theme_minimal()

```

# HTA function
```{r}
# ---- HTI / HTA utilities ----
hti <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(0)
  if (is.factor(x)) x <- droplevels(x)
  tab <- table(x)
  p <- as.numeric(tab) / sum(tab)
  p <- p[p > 0]
  C <- length(p)
  if (C <= 1) return(0)
  -sum(p * log(p)) / log(C)
}

qbreaks <- function(v, k) {
  br <- unique(quantile(v, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = k + 1), na.rm = TRUE))
  if (length(br) < k + 1) br <- unique(pretty(v, n = k))
  br
}

# ---- PCA-based HTA (no p-values / permutations) ----
compute_hta_pca <- function(df, pca_fit,
                            region_pcs = c(1, 2), region_k = 2,
                            trait_pcs  = c(3, 4, 5), trait_k  = 3,
                            min_cell_n = 5) {

  scores <- as.data.frame(pca_fit$x)

  # df and PCA scores must align row-by-row
  if (nrow(df) != nrow(scores)) {
    stop("nrow(df) != nrow(pca_fit$x). Fit PCA on the same df rows you pass here.")
  }

  # Add PC scores into df (optional but convenient)
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(scores))) df[[paste0("PC", j)]] <- scores[[j]]

  # ---- Regions from PC1 & PC2 ----
  pcA <- paste0("PC", region_pcs[1])
  pcB <- paste0("PC", region_pcs[2])

  brA <- qbreaks(df[[pcA]], region_k)
  brB <- qbreaks(df[[pcB]], region_k)

  df$Reg1Bin <- cut(df[[pcA]], breaks = brA, include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE)
  df$Reg2Bin <- cut(df[[pcB]], breaks = brB, include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE)
  df$cell    <- interaction(df$Reg1Bin, df$Reg2Bin, drop = TRUE)

  # ---- Traits from PC3..PC5 (or whatever you pass) ----
  trait_bin_cols <- character(length(trait_pcs))
  trait_breaks <- vector("list", length(trait_pcs))

  for (i in seq_along(trait_pcs)) {
    pcname <- paste0("PC", trait_pcs[i])
    br <- qbreaks(df[[pcname]], trait_k)
    trait_breaks[[i]] <- br

    colnm <- paste0(pcname, "Bin")
    df[[colnm]] <- cut(df[[pcname]], breaks = br, include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE)
    df[[colnm]] <- factor(df[[colnm]])
    trait_bin_cols[i] <- colnm
  }
  names(trait_breaks) <- paste0("PC", trait_pcs)

  # Trait combos on complete rows only
  complete_traits <- stats::complete.cases(df[, trait_bin_cols, drop = FALSE])
  traits_all <- interaction(df[, trait_bin_cols, drop = FALSE], drop = TRUE)
  traits     <- as.character(traits_all[complete_traits])
  cells      <- droplevels(df$cell[complete_traits])

  # Split by cell and enforce min size
  by_cell <- split(traits, cells)
  cell_n  <- sapply(by_cell, length)
  keep    <- cell_n >= min_cell_n
  by_cell <- by_cell[keep]
  cell_n  <- cell_n[keep]

  if (length(by_cell) == 0) {
    stop("No cells left after filtering; use coarser region_k or lower min_cell_n.")
  }

  # Local HTIs and weighted HTA
  local_hti <- sapply(by_cell, hti)
  w <- cell_n
  HTA <- sum(w * local_hti) / sum(w)

  list(
    HTA        = HTA,
    cells_used = length(by_cell),
    total_n    = sum(w),
    region_breaks = list(Reg1 = brA, Reg2 = brB),
    trait_breaks  = trait_breaks,
    local_hti  = local_hti,
    cell_n     = w,
    cells_used_names = names(by_cell)
  )
}
```

## visualization
```{r}
qbreaks <- function(v, k) {
  br <- unique(quantile(v, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = k + 1), na.rm = TRUE))
  if (length(br) < k + 1) br <- unique(pretty(v, n = k))
  br
}

scores <- as.data.frame(pca_fit$x)

# 1) Define PC1/PC2 region bins as INTERVALS (2 bins each)
pc1_br <- qbreaks(scores$PC1, 2)
pc2_br <- qbreaks(scores$PC2, 2)

df_vis <- health_data %>%
  mutate(
    PC1Bin = cut(scores$PC1, breaks = pc1_br, include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE),
    PC2Bin = cut(scores$PC2, breaks = pc2_br, include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE),
    cell   = interaction(PC1Bin, PC2Bin, drop = TRUE)
  )

# 2) Trait composition within each cell (proportions)
comp <- df_vis %>%
  count(PC1Bin, PC2Bin, cell, trait, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(cell) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3) Plot in the same style (one bar per facet)
ggplot(comp, aes(x = "cell", y = prop, fill = trait)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_grid(PC2Bin ~ PC1Bin) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Trait composition within each PC1×PC2 cell (2×2 grid)",
    x = NULL, y = "Proportion within cell"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 0)
  )
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
n <- 5000

health_homo <- health_data[rep(1, n), , drop = FALSE]

# -----------------------
# CATEGORICAL
# -----------------------

tab <- sort(table(health_data$Gender, useNA = "no"), decreasing = TRUE)
lv  <- names(tab)

p <- rep(0, length(lv))
p[1] <- 0.8
if (length(lv) >= 2) p[2] <- 0.1
if (length(lv) > 2) p[3:length(lv)] <- 0  # keep any unexpected levels at 0 prob

health_homo$Gender <- sample(lv, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p / sum(p))

# Medical.Condition (3+ levels likely)
tab <- sort(table(health_data$Medical.Condition, useNA = "no"), decreasing = TRUE)
lv  <- names(tab)
p   <- rep(0, length(lv))
p[1] <- 0.85; p[2] <- 0.10
if (length(lv) > 2) p[3:length(lv)] <- 0.05 / (length(lv) - 2)
health_homo$Medical.Condition <- sample(lv, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p)

# -----------------------
# NUMERIC / INTEGER
# -----------------------

# Age
mu <- mean(health_data$Age, na.rm = TRUE); s <- sd(health_data$Age, na.rm = TRUE)
health_homo$Age <- rnorm(n, mu, 0.5 * s)

# Glucose
mu <- mean(health_data$Glucose, na.rm = TRUE); s <- sd(health_data$Glucose, na.rm = TRUE)
health_homo$Glucose <- rnorm(n, mu, 0.5 * s)

health_homo$Blood.Pressure <- rnorm(n, mu, 0.5 * s)

# BMI

mu <- mean(health_data$Oxygen.Saturation, na.rm = TRUE); s <- sd(health_data$Oxygen.Saturation, na.rm = TRUE)
health_homo$Oxygen.Saturation <- rnorm(n, mu, 0.5 * s)

# LengthOfStay (integer)

health_homo$LengthOfStay <- as.integer(round(rnorm(n, mu, 0.5 * s)))

# Cholesterol

health_homo$Cholesterol <- rnorm(n, mu, 0.5 * s)

# Triglycerides
```

```{r}
  levels = c(
    "Age_Low__BMI_Low",
    "Age_Low__BMI_High",
```

```{r}
## 1) select variables (exclude Age and BMI)
X <- subset(health_data, select = -c(Age, BMI))

## keep only numeric columns (PCA needs numeric)
X_num <- X[, sapply(X, is.numeric), drop = FALSE]

## 2) standardize (z-score)
X_scaled <- scale(X_num, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

## 3) PCA
pca_fit <- prcomp(X_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

## 4) Scree plot (base R)
eig <- pca_fit$sdev^2
pve <- eig / sum(eig)

plot(
  pve,
  type = "b",
  xlab = "Principal Component",
  ylab = "Proportion of Variance Explained",
  main = "Scree Plot (PCA on standardized variables, excluding Age & BMI)"
)

## optional: cumulative PVE line
lines(cumsum(pve), type = "b")
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("PVE", "Cumulative PVE"),
  lty = 1,
  pch = 1,
  bty = "n"
)
```

```{r}
# 8 traits defined by pc1, pc2 and pc3

scores <- as.data.frame(pca_fit$x)

bin_extreme <- function(v, p = 0.2) {
  ql <- quantile(v, p, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)
  qh <- quantile(v, 1 - p, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)
  out <- rep("M", length(v))
  out[v <= ql] <- "L"
  out[v >= qh] <- "H"
  out
}

health_data$trait <- paste0(
  "PC1_", bin_extreme(scores$PC1),
  "__PC2_", bin_extreme(scores$PC2),
  "__PC3_", bin_extreme(scores$PC3)
)

health_data$trait <- factor(health_data$trait)
table(health_data$trait)
```


```{r}
compute_ht <- function(df, region_col = "region_2x2", trait_col = "trait") {
  ok <- !is.na(df[[region_col]]) & !is.na(df[[trait_col]])
  d <- df[ok, , drop = FALSE]

  trait_levels <- levels(d[[trait_col]])
  if (is.null(trait_levels) || anyNA(trait_levels)) {
    trait_levels <- sort(unique(d[[trait_col]]))
  }
  C <- length(trait_levels)
  if (C <= 1) stop("Need >= 2 trait categories to compute HTI/HTA.")

  hti_region <- function(x) {
    tab <- table(factor(x, levels = trait_levels))
    p <- as.numeric(tab) / sum(tab)
    p <- p[p > 0]
    -sum(p * log(p)) / log(C)  # normalized Shannon entropy
  }

  regions <- levels(d[[region_col]])
  if (is.null(regions) || anyNA(regions)) regions <- sort(unique(d[[region_col]]))

  n_by_region <- sapply(regions, \(r) sum(d[[region_col]] == r))
  local_hti   <- sapply(regions, \(r) hti_region(d[[trait_col]][d[[region_col]] == r]))
  weights     <- n_by_region / sum(n_by_region)
  HTA         <- sum(weights * local_hti)

  list(
    HTA = HTA,
    local_hti = local_hti,
    n_by_region = n_by_region,
    weights = weights
  )
}

res <- compute_ht(health_data)
res$HTA
res$local_hti
```

```{r}
  scores$PC1,

  region_col = "region_2x2",
```

# compute hta ml

```{r}
compute_hta_ml <- function(df, region_col, trait_col, pc1_scores) {
  # make a local copy
  dat <- df
  
  # attach continuous PC1 scores used for sigma^2
  dat$pc1_score_ml <- pc1_scores
  
  # get ordinary HTA result first
  ht_res <- compute_ht(
    dat,
    region_col = region_col,
    trait_col = trait_col
  )
  
  # local HTI table
  local_hti_df <- data.frame(
    region = names(ht_res$local_hti),
    local_hti = as.numeric(ht_res$local_hti),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # per-region n and sigma^2 from raw PC1 scores
  region_stats <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(split(dat, dat[[region_col]]), function(x) {
      n_r <- sum(!is.na(x$pc1_score_ml))
      sigma2_r <- if (n_r >= 2) var(x$pc1_score_ml, na.rm = TRUE) else 0
      
      data.frame(
        region = as.character(x[[region_col]][1]),
        n = n_r,
        sigma2 = sigma2_r,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    })
  )
  
  # merge everything
  out <- merge(local_hti_df, region_stats, by = "region", all.x = TRUE)
  
  # adjusted local score
  out$hti_ml <- out$local_hti * (out$sigma2 / out$n)
  
  # final average across cells
  hta_ml <- mean(out$hti_ml, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  list(
    HTA = ht_res$HTA,
    local_hti = ht_res$local_hti,
    region_stats = out,
    HTA_ML = hta_ml
  )
}
```


```{r}
# heterogeneous dataset
pc1_scores_het <- scores$PC1

res_pc1_tertile_ml <- compute_hta_ml(
  df = health_data,
  region_col = "region_2x2",
  trait_col = "trait_pc1_tertile",
  pc1_scores = pc1_scores_het
)

res_pc1_tertile_ml$HTA
res_pc1_tertile_ml$HTA_ML
res_pc1_tertile_ml$region_stats
```


```{r}
res_pc1_tertile_ml$region_stats[, c("region", "local_hti", "sigma2", "n", "hti_ml")]
```

$$
HTA_{ML}=\sum_{r}\frac{n_r}{N}\left(HTI_r\times\frac{\sigma_r^2}{n_r}\right)
=\sum_{r}\frac{HTI_r\,\sigma_r^2}{N}
$$

```{r}

res_pc1_tertile_homo_ml <- compute_hta_ml(

  trait_col = "trait_pc1_tertile",

)
```

```{r}
age_q <- quantile(health_homo$Age, probs = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)
bmi_q <- quantile(health_homo$BMI, probs = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)

health_homo$age_bin <- ifelse(health_homo$Age <= age_q, "Age_Low", "Age_High")
health_homo$bmi_bin <- ifelse(health_homo$BMI <= bmi_q, "BMI_Low", "BMI_High")

health_homo$region_2x2 <- paste(health_homo$age_bin, health_homo$bmi_bin, sep = "__")

health_homo$region_2x2 <- factor(
  health_homo$region_2x2,
  levels = c(
    "Age_Low__BMI_Low",
    "Age_Low__BMI_High",
    "Age_High__BMI_Low",
    "Age_High__BMI_High"
  )
)

table(health_homo$region_2x2, useNA = "ifany")
age_q; bmi_q
```


```{r}
## 1) select variables (exclude Age and BMI)
X_homo <- subset(health_homo, select = -c(Age, BMI))

## keep only numeric columns (PCA needs numeric)
X_num_homo <- X_homo[, sapply(X_homo, is.numeric), drop = FALSE]

## 2) standardize (z-score)
X_scaled_homo <- scale(X_num_homo, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

## 3) PCA
pca_fit_homo <- prcomp(X_scaled_homo, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

## 4) Scree plot (base R)
eig <- pca_fit_homo$sdev^2
pve <- eig / sum(eig)

plot(
  pve,
  type = "b",
  xlab = "Principal Component",
  ylab = "Proportion of Variance Explained",
  main = "Scree Plot (PCA on standardized variables, excluding Age & BMI)"
)

## optional: cumulative PVE line
lines(cumsum(pve), type = "b")
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("PVE", "Cumulative PVE"),
  lty = 1,
  pch = 1,
  bty = "n"
)
```
